TC-001: Scale test at 10,000 concurrent users
  Precondition: System is operational and ready for load testing.
  Step: Simulate 10,000 concurrent users accessing the system.
  Expected: System handles all requests without failure.

TC-002: Scale test at 10,001 concurrent users
  Precondition: System is operational and ready for load testing.
  Step: Simulate 10,001 concurrent users accessing the system.
  Expected: System handles all requests without failure.

TC-003: Critical functionality response time
  Precondition: Patient registration functionality is available.
  Step: Execute patient registration with minimal valid data.
  Expected: Response time <= 2 seconds.

TC-004: Other function response time during peak
  Precondition: System is under peak load (10,000 concurrent users) and specialty addition functionality is available.
  Step: Execute specialty addition with minimal valid data under peak load.
  Expected: Response time <= 4 seconds.

TC-005: Availability during 4th Sunday window
  Precondition: Current date is the 4th Sunday of the month and time is between 12:00 AM and 12:10 AM.
  Step: Check system availability by sending health check requests every second for 10 minutes.
  Expected: All health check requests are successful.

TC-006: Patient registration positive
  Precondition: User is authenticated as a patient registration user.
  Step: Submit patient registration form with all required fields.
  Expected: Patient is registered and confirmation message is displayed.

TC-007: Patient registration negative (missing required field)
  Precondition: User is authenticated as a patient registration user.
  Step: Submit patient registration form with a required field missing.
  Expected: Error message indicating missing required field is displayed.

TC-008: Admin add specialty positive
  Precondition: Admin is authenticated and has permission to add specialties.
  Step: Submit specialty name "Cardiology" (valid).
  Expected: Specialty "Cardiology" is added to the system.

TC-009: Admin add specialty negative (empty name)
  Precondition: Admin is authenticated and has permission to add specialties.
  Step: Submit specialty name as empty string.
  Expected: Error message indicating specialty name cannot be empty.

TC-010: Admin register doctor positive
  Precondition: Admin is authenticated and has permission to register doctors.
  Step: Submit doctor registration form with all required fields.
  Expected: Doctor is registered and confirmation message is displayed.

TC-011: Admin register doctor negative (missing required field)
  Precondition: Admin is authenticated and has permission to register doctors.
  Step: Submit doctor registration form with a required field missing.
  Expected: Error message indicating missing required field is displayed.
